verdict.rationale: Lithic surfaces fraud signals at authorization time: Auth Rules can key on risk score, MCC, and country at the program, account, or card level, with shadow mode and backtesting. ASA lets you plug your own models into the live authorization decision, and the rules engine also covers 3DS and tokenization streams. However, nothing shows dedicated suspicious-activity alerts beyond generic webhooks, and nothing shows tooling to block and reissue compromised cards. Missing for 10: suspicious-activity or fraud alerting, card block/pause and reissue workflow, independent corroboration of fraud effectiveness.
